name: What types of moldings are included in kitchen trim installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of moldings are included in kitchen trim installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen trim installation includes baseboards, crown molding along cabinets or ceilings, light rail moldings, window and door casings, and toe kicks. A complete trim package also frequently includes filler strips, corner blocks, and shoe molding to conceal gaps along newly tiled or hardwood floors. As finish carpentry specialists, HH Remodeling evaluates ceiling heights and cabinetry layouts to determine which profiles fit best. Crown molding bridges the gap between top cabinets and uneven ceilings, while toe kicks seal underneath base cabinets to protect framing and block debris. Matching the profile to your overall design ensures a cohesive transition across nearby dining or living areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen trim includes crown molding, baseboards, window casings, toe kicks, light rail moldings, and shoe molding to give your cabinets and walls a seamless, finished look.
